name: Rev. Dereca Blackmon
reason: No website of her own could be found: two web searches (4 Nov 2026) turned up only third-party pages (a book festival speaker page, podcast pages, Stanford pages, an unclaimed directory listing for her Inclusion Design Group), so there is no own-site source for an email or contact form, base, photo or offerings. Her main published work is diversity and inclusion consulting and training, and her Shift courses were on racial justice allyship; a podcast page says she is now senior minister of a Center for Spiritual Living congregation in Oakland, whose site was not found in the results and was not guessed.
